Summary

We have a requirement to develop a web-based platform allowing for the ability to monitor, interrogate and provide report on Audio-Visual equipment. The platform will be able to communicate with devices via a network provided by the customer or via the Internet.

The platform will be able to pull information from a list of pre-defined devices, Push configuration changes to devices and pull usage information from each device. The platform will communicate using a set of pre-defined “drivers” and will communicate on pre-defined ports supported by the manufacturer.

Each set of information will have the ability to be grouped by a physical location and presented using a hierarchy type format.

All information will be presented through a Web Portal based in AWS and will allow for role-based access.

Application Security

All data should be held and managed within the UK. Users should be granted access on Least-Privilege basis.

All data should be encrypted at Rest and in transit.

Authentication / Authorisation

Login

All users will be required to login to the platform using a username and password. This will be supported by multi-factor authentication. The platform should also support Single Sign On (including support for NHS & GOV.UK) based on the customer requirements.

Roles

All users will be allocated a minimum of one role but can hold more than one role supporting multiple activities across the platform.

Each role will provide access to elements of the platform and will limit the visibility and access to other areas of the platform.

Hosting & Infrastructure

The platform and all its components should be hosted in the UK using AWS. All data should be processed and held within the UK. The platform should support High availability, resilience and secure connectivity.

The platform should offer a full API to allow other systems to integrate.

Customisation

The platform should support the following customisation per customer.

*   Ability to upload a logo and present this in agreed locations withing the platform.
*   Ability to change colours to support customer branding.
*   Ability to change keywords/placeholder text.

Location Management

The platform will support a “tree” style location management system. The structure should be designed in the following format:

*   Customer
    *   Region
        *   Location
            *   Building
                *   Room

When adding a device, it should be added to the Room level. All Regions, Buildings, Rooms and devices will be filterable and will have the ability to be reported on.

Device Management

Equipment Inventory

The platform should hold set of pre-defined equipment based on the customer deployment. Each device will require to be added to the system with the following information:

*   Physical location
*   Device API or Driver
*   IP address
*   Connection type (Rest API, Telnet, SSH)

The data will start to be collected when the device is added to the platform. This will include the following information about each device and will be retrieved by the devices API or driver. This information should be the minimum data collected; other data may be available per device based on its API.

*   Manufacturer
*   Model
*   Local Device name
*   Serial Number
*   Firmware / Software version
*   IP Address
*   MAC Address
*   Current State
*   Call Status
*   Volume Level

Changes

The platform will support making changes to a device in real time. This will include but is not limited to any of the values listed as part of the Equipment inventory section.

Firmware Management

The platform will support the ability to identify devices with outdated firmware. This information should then be presented as a summary to allow action to be taken.

Device Control

Real-Time Updates

The platform should be capable of pushing Real-time updates to devices or a group of devices. This should be sent via the API and feedback provided to the user upon completion.

Updates should include but not be limited to:

*   Placing a call via a video system
*   Setting Audio levels
*   Setting Display Inputs
*   Powering a system up / down
*   Resetting a system to its default settings

Device Monitoring

Alerts

The platform will be capable of creating alerts based on key metrics and their status.

All devices within the platform will have the ability to present an alert to a dashboard or via email. The following should be available:

Configurable alert rule examples:

*   Device offline
*   Performance thresholds

Notification channels:

*   Email
*   SMS
*   MS Teams
*   In-app notifications
*   CRM Integration (Service Now, Dynamics 365 etc…)

Testing

The platform will allow the ability to create, edit and hold pre-defined actions that can be performed on a device or set of devices at a scheduled time. This functionality should also be able to run on an ad-hoc basis.

Functionality should include but not be limited to:

*   Placing a call via a video system
*   Setting Audio levels
*   Setting Display Inputs
*   Powering a system up / down
*   Receiving audio levels via microphones

Following the completion of the test a report should be made available to the end user. In the event of any failures during the test this should also be logged, and an alert raised via the dashboard and sent via email to a designated user or group of users.

Reporting

The platform will be capable of retaining data regarding the logical rooms or locations that have been created. The data will be accessible to allow for the creation of dashboards and exportable reports through Excel or via a secure API.

In addition to collecting data directly from the devices it will also be capable of collecting data from other platform infrastructure via REST API.

Room Usage

The platform will track the usage of a Room including when the Audio-Visual system is in use and in Standby mode. The platform will also hold a room availability matrix to allow the production of a Utilisation figure.

Device Usage

The platform will collect data from devices regarding their usage whilst in use and in standby mode. The data should be retrieved via the device API or Driver.

Power Consumption

The platform will collect data from devices regarding their power consumption whilst in use and in standby mode. The data should be retrieved via the device API or Driver.

Dashboards

The platform will support the creation of Dashboards to present data collected from Rooms, Devices and other infrastructure. The dashboards will include Tables, list views and graphical representation of the data and will be fully customisable for the end-user

Audit logging

All actions within the product should be logged ensuring an audit trail. This should include but not be limited to:

*   User activity (Login info, activity within the product.)
*   Device activity (Online/offline status, changes.)
*   Errors

Assumptions

*   Devices expose APIs or control interfaces
*   Customers may require on-prem gateway for internal devices
*   Internet connectivity is available for cloud communication
*   Initial integrations will target a limited set of AV device vendors

Constraints

*   Variability in third-party device protocols
*   Network/firewall restrictions in customer environments
*   Real-time performance expectations
*   Scalability requirements across multiple tenants

Success Criteria

*   Platform can onboard and monitor devices across multiple customers
*   Real-time device status visibility
*   Successful execution of remote commands
*   Secure multi-tenant operation
*   Positive user feedback from pilot customers

Future Enhancements

Whilst designing the platform, the following should be kept in mind as a future improvement

*   AI-driven predictive maintenance
*   Advanced automation workflows
*   Native mobile apps
*   Expanded device/vendor integrations
*   Voice or natural language control interface
